title: What a Real Shelby Cobra Costs Today
description:
A Shelby Cobra four hundred twenty-seven cost seven thousand, five hundred dollars new. A Hagerty price guide dated April twenty twenty-five values a good condition one at two point two five million. That is three hundred times the original price. But a car that looks the same, a continuation Cobra, sold in March twenty twenty-four for three hundred thirty-five thousand. This is what a real Shelby Cobra costs today, and how to tell which one you are looking at. Here is the twist. The same chassis number can appear in two very different price lists. One Cobra sold in the twenty-tens for nine hundred two thousand dollars and later for one point six five five million. Another sold in two thousand five for five hundred thirty-five thousand and later for one point three two five million. And one of the cars that looks like a Cobra is not an original at all. Stay to the end.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
